summary: The diff adds a Motoko backend actor with per-principal food entries (including macros/micros, portion size, and confidence), plus frontend routing and UI components for login gating, entry estimation/confirmation with portion+confidence sliders, charts (line + pie) and a macro-based “nutrition balance” rating, and a rules/FAQ-style helper chat UI. However, some requirements are either not evidenced (due to truncation/omissions) or appear unimplemented: stable persistence + full CRUD on the backend, and using the generated logo asset in the app header (and ensuring the required generated image files exist).

missing_requirements.requirement: Persist food entries across page refresh and canister calls (stable storage).
missing_requirements.reason: The backend shows in-memory vars/maps (`var nextEntryId`, `let foodEntries = Map.empty...`) but no stable variables or `preupgrade`/`postupgrade` logic is visible in the provided `backend/main.mo` excerpt. With only the shown code, persistence across upgrades/refreshes is not evidenced.

missing_requirements.requirement: Expose CRUD methods needed by the UI to create and list entries (CRUD).
missing_requirements.reason: The backend excerpt includes `addFoodEntry` (create) and `getFoodEntriesForCaller` (list), but no update or delete methods are shown. If full CRUD is intended, update/delete are not evidenced in the diff summary.

missing_requirements.requirement: Render the generated static logo asset in the UI (e.g., in the app header).
missing_requirements.reason: `AppHeader` renders a Lucide `Leaf` icon and the text “NutriScan”, but does not render the required generated logo image (`/assets/generated/app-logo.dim_512x512.png`).

missing_requirements.requirement: Generated images exist under `frontend/public/assets/generated` with the exact required filenames (logo + 3 illustrations + scan frame overlay).
missing_requirements.reason: The diff summary does not include any added image files under `frontend/public/assets/generated` (and notes many omitted added files). Only a reference to one required image is visible in code; existence of the actual files and all required filenames is not evidenced from the provided diff summary.

hallucinated_features.description: Admin/role-based access control initialization using a secret URL parameter (`caffeineAdminToken`) and `_initializeAccessControlWithSecret`.
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest does not ask for admin tokens, secret URL parameters, or role-based access control initialization; it only requires per-Internet-Identity user separation.

hallucinated_features.description: User profile creation/setup flow (name-based profile stored in canister) and a mandatory profile setup dialog after login.
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest requirements focus on diet entries, dashboard, camera flow, graphs, and helper chat; a user profile model and onboarding dialog are not requested.

hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested by the BuildRequest and not part of any acceptance criteria.
